title: Sources: OpenAI is on track to generate annualized revenue of $40B+ based on its current performance, roughly doubling its run rate from the end of 2025 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: OpenAI is on track to generate annualized revenue of $40B+ based on its current performance, roughly doubling its run rate from the end of 2025 — OpenAI is on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $40 billion based on its current performance, according to people familiar …
